angle: Place-based directories: port authority/port-district tenant lists and maps (Port Fourchon 2026 map, Port of Iberia directory, Port of Terrebonne, Port of West St. Mary, Quonset Business Park tenant list, Port of San Diego shipyards page, Port of Brownsville directory [blocked], Port of Pittsburgh port district), state economic-development / cluster pages (MDA, TN ECD, LED/GNO, Hampton Roads Alliance, Kitsap EDA, Terrebonne top-employer list, Mobile Chamber), regional association member lists (Puget Sound Shipbuilders Association, Inland Rivers Ports & Terminals, GICA [blocked], North Coast Marine Mfg Alliance [JS, empty]), and local news on each port's yards (Waterways Journal, Riviera, Inquirer, 10/12 Industry Report). Each name resolved to a plant via the company's own site where reachable.
searches_until_dry: not reached: stopped at the 30-search cap. Searches 27-30 each still added 1-3 new names (CGB St. Louis, Thomassie, Leevac, Basic Marine, New Pacific Industrial). Searches 20 (ME/NC/SC/GA) and 26 (Pittsburgh) added little or nothing.
notes: Records: 93 total, 92 unique sites (Halter Marine row duplicates Bollinger Mississippi Shipbuilding), 67 in definition, 51 in definition with plant_confirmed and quote_verified true.
Confirmed sub-counts (overlapping): {"boundary": 7, "dated": 2, "trade_press_only": 3, "off_method": 0, "coded_lead": 0}; confirmed with no flag: 39.
Dedup assumption: Halter Marine (mississippi.org) and Bollinger Mississippi Shipbuilding are treated as the same Pascagoula yard; no fetched page links them.

Riviera towboat roundup (trade press) is the only source for Halimar, Diversified Marine (Bourg), FMT and Sneed; flagged trade_press_only. Diversified Marine Inc. (Portland OR) came from a mis-resolved domain guess (off_method) and is plant_confirmed=false (PO box only).

All quotes were checked with tools/fetch_page.py --check; every non-empty quote returned FOUND. Rows with empty quote are unresolved names (site down, 403, or snippet-only) and are plant_confirmed=false.

WebSearch used for discovery only (30 queries, blocked domains: shipbuildinghistory.com, workboat.com, marinelog.com). No OSHA, EPA/NAICS, MARAD grant/survey lists, SCA lists, HII/EB partner lists, or welder postings were used; the MARAD shipbuilding-facilities survey PDF surfaced in results 3 times and was deliberately not opened.
